{{Quote|Did we beat Meeta Cors' ''Nautilian'' out of stardock?|Gial Ackbar, in an annotation in ''The Rebel Files'' in 34 ABY|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
The '''''Nautilian''''' was an [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]] that served in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Endor|decisive battle]] fought at [[Endor]], where it was entirely obliterated by the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. In [[34 ABY]], [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] and Admiral [[Ushos O. Statura]] exchanged annotations about the ''Nautilian'' in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''.

==Description==
The ''Nautilian''<ref name="Life Debt" /> was an [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]]<ref name="Episode VI" /> produced by [[Mon Calamari Shipyards]].<ref name="UltimateSW" /> Like the other [[Starship|ships]] of its class, the ''Nautilian'' measured at 1,300 [[meter]]s and was armed with six [[tractor beam projector]]s, twenty-nine [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s, and thirty-six [[ion cannon]]s. It could reach speeds of 975 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] using its ten [[ion engine]]s.<ref name="Starfighters" />

It was also equipped with a [[deflector shield generator]],<ref name="Databank" /> a class one [[hyperdrive]], and at least one [[hangar]] bay<ref name="Starfighters" /> that could house ten [[squadron]]s of [[starfighter]]s.<ref name="UltimateSW" />

==History==
===Early service===
{{Quote|The ship's brittle construction ultimately hampared its rollout, particularly after the Ishanna inversion.|Ushos O. Statura, in an annotation on ''The Rebel Files'' in 34 ABY|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
[[File:Wingless_MC80_toast.png|thumb|left|250px|The Death Star II fires on the ''Nautilian'', destroying it]]
During the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]], the ''Nautilian'' was under the command of [[Meeta Cors]] whilst it was being refitted into combat service in a rebel [[Telaris rebel stardocks|stardock]] in the [[Telaris cometary cloud]]. A [[refugee]] [[Mon Cala]] [[city-ship]], the ''Nautilian'' was among the first to be completed in their conversion into combat-ready vessels, coming behind [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]]' [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'', and Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]]'s MC80A ''[[Home One]]'', despite the ''Nautilian''{{'s}} delicate construction being hampered, particularly after the [[Ishanna inversion]], which affected its launch.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

===Battle of Endor===
{{Quote|Another rebel ship destroyed!|Imperial Colonel Emarr Ottkreg, reacting to the destruction of the ''Nautilian''|<ref name="Levers of Power">{{StoryCite|story=The Levers of Power|book=The Rise of the Empire}}</ref>}}
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War]], the ''Nautilian'' was among several MC80A star cruisers present at the [[Battle of Endor]], with its goal, along with the other capital ships, to secure a perimeter around the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] while rebel starfighters breached the incomplete superstructure and destroy the [[reactor]]. During the battle, the Alliance [[Fleet]] was caught in a trap by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. As the Alliance Fleet and [[Imperial Navy]] engaged each other, an [[MC80 Star Cruiser]] the ''[[Liberty]]'', was destroyed by a blast that originated from the second Death Star, revealing that the [[battle station]], while incomplete, was fully operational.<ref name="Episode VI" />

As [[Gold Leader]] [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] spoke with Ackbar on moving the rebel fleet closer to the Imperial [[Star Destroyer]]s, the ''Nautilian'' was destroyed by a second blast from the Death Star.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vigilance (Imperial-class)|''Vigilance'']], [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Colonel]] [[Emarr Ottkreg]] reacted with triumph on the destruction of the ''Nautilian''.<ref name="Levers of Power" /> Eventually, the Rebel Alliance managed to deactivate the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator|deflector shield generator]] protecting the [[space station]], allowing for rebel starfighters to destroy the main reactor and ultimately the second [[Death Star]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

===Legacy===
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">Since ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' were buried on the same [[Standard day|day]] as the [[Battle of Endor]], which according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' takes place in [[4 ABY]], and because ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' establishes that ''The Rebel Files'' were rediscovered 30 [[Standard year|years]] after the battle, it can be determined that ''The Rebel Files'' were uncovered in [[34 ABY]].</ref> after ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' were [[Excavation on Durkteel|recovered]] by the [[Resistance]], Ackbar wrote an annotation on a document on whether ''Home One'' beat Cors' ''Nautilian'' during combat conversion, with Admiral [[Ushos O. Statura]] writing that Ackbar was correct.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Owners and operators==
Crewed by over 5,000,<ref name="UltimateSW" /> the ''Nautilian'' was owned by Meeta Cors during its early service to the nascent Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Nautilian'' first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[1983]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> It was identified in the [[2016]] [[canon]] novel, ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'', written by [[Chuck Wendig]].<ref name="Life Debt" />
